headline: The Aqaba–Shidiyya–Ma'an railway project places the south of the Kingdom on the regional industrialisation map
summary: Economic experts said the national Aqaba–Shidiyya–Ma'an railway is a strategic pillar of Jordan's 2023–2033 modernisation vision. They describe it as a driver that could place southern Jordan on the regional industrialisation map.
why: Rail infrastructure lowers freight costs and supports industrial investment, which matters for long-term growth in regional economies.
